bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
container="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -E '(^|[-_])gaybbs([-_]|$)' | head -n 1)"
test -n "$container" || exit 80
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$container")" = true || exit 81
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$container")" = "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:bugreport-cfc999ac)" || exit 82
if docker logs --since 5m "$container" 2>&1 | grep -q 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY'; then echo GAYBBS_BOT_READY=PASS; exit 0; fi
if docker logs --since 5m "$container" 2>&1 | grep -Eq 'Error:|FATAL|Unhandled|BOT_IDENTITY_MISMATCH'; then echo GAYBBS_BOT_STARTUP_ERROR; exit 83; fi
echo GAYBBS_BOT_READY_NOT_YET_OBSERVED
exit 84
